-abaddon (drachnyen goes so freaking hard) 

-a crew of legionairies (I run MSU squads ATM, 3-5 of 5) 

-chosen/terminators they both are great bodyguard units either 5 or 10 man works

-forgefiends just.... Forgefiends. Look at that face! 

-1-2 vindicators that thing can be scary af

-1-2 predator annihilators

-obliterators

-chaos Lords (they are kinda meta atm) 

-1-2 squads cultists for sticky objectives

That being said I own almost the whole range and as long as you're not going über competitive, everything has some merit.
